list.name: Lucky
list.description: 3x per long rest, reroll a d20. +1 to all saves.

list.name: Tough
list.description: +2 HP per level (retroactive). You're harder to kill.

list.name: War Caster
list.description: Advantage on concentration saves. +2 to spellcasting ability.

list.name: Great Weapon Master
list.description: Heavy weapon crits deal +10 damage. +2 STR.

list.name: Sentinel
list.description: Enemies you hit can't disengage. +1 AC.

list.name: Alert
list.description: Can't be surprised. +5 to initiative. +2 DEX.

list.name: Magic Initiate
list.description: Learn 2 cantrips and 1 spell from any class. +2 INT.
